item.title: [DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Mon 19:17): Bombendrohungen | Klinikbrand | Cottbuser Weihnachtsmarkt
item.description:
Originally published Mon 23 Nov 2026 19:17 IST.
Hunderte Schulen haben Bombendrohungen erhalten, auch in Berlin und Brandenburg. Die Polizei geht nicht von einer Gefahr aus. Weitere Themen: 15 Verletzte bei Brand in Klinik in Berlin-Lichtenberg, Strom-Spar-Check vom Bundesumweltministerium und Weihnachtsmarkt in Cottbus.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Mon 18:08): Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO
item.description:
Originally published Mon 23 Nov 2026 18:08 IST.

Shares in the tech giant Nvidia soar as its board votes unanimously to reappoint Huang as CEO and President, less than two weeks after he was forced to resign over reports of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. President Trump welcomed his return, calling him a great patriot. Also: President Zelensky confirms that Ukrainian drones attacked two Russian ships off Libya's coast, sinking one of them; a BBC exclusive report on the radical far-left movement in France that President Emmanuel Macron says is trying to bring down the French Republic; how Chile is reducing methane emissions by using food scraps and other organic waste to generate electricity; and we remember Ian "Molly" Meldrum, Australia's host of Countdown and music personality, who helped introduce ABBA, Blondie and Elton John to an Australian audience.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
